Default Commit Types

The default list of commit types for commit fusion

TypeDescriptionEmoji
changesIntroduce breaking changes.💥
featIntroduce new features.✨
fixFixed a problem.🩹
removeRemove code or files.🔥
docsUpdate Documentation.📝
styleUpdate style.💄
perfImprove performance.⚡️
testsAdd tests.✅
buildBuild.📦
cicdAdd / Update Continuous integration.👷
choreAdd / Update Tooling, Generic commit🔧
revertRevert changes to previous commit⏪
bookmarkRelease / Version tags.🔖
wipWork in progress.🚧
gitignoreAdd / Update a .gitignore file.🙈
gitsubmoduleAdd / Update git submodules🧮
flagAdd, update, or remove feature flags.🚩
improveImprove structure / format of the code.🛠️
hotfixCritical hotfix.🚑️
deployDeploy stuff.🚀
projectBegin a project.🎉
securityFix security issues.🔒️
refactorRefactor code.♻️
depaddAdd a dependency.➕
depdellRemove a dependency.➖
configAdd or update configuration files.🔧
typosFix typos.✏️
resourcesMove or rename🚚
deadcodeRemove dead code.⚰️
DepreRemove deprecate code.🗑️
concurrencyAdd or update code related to multithreading or concurrency.🧵
InfraInfrastructure related changes.🧱
compilerFix compiler / linter warnings.🚨
cifixFix CI Build.💚
depdownDowngrade dependencies.⏬
depupUpgrade dependencies.⏫
depfixPin dependencies to specific versions.📌
globlocInternationalization and localization.🌐
initBegin a project.🎉
secretsAdd or update secrets.🔐
analyticsAdd or update analytics or track code.📈
scriptsAdd or update development scripts.🔨
mergeMerge branches.🔀
api-updateUpdate code due to external API changes.👽️
licenseAdd or update license.📄
assetsAdd or update assets.🍱
AccessImprove accessibility.♿️
commetsAdd or update comments in source code.💡
dbPerform database related changes.🗃️
logAddAdd or update logs.🔊
logRemoveRemove logs.🔇
contribAdd or update contributor(s).👥
usabilityImprove user experience / usability.🚸
mockMock things.🤡
experimentPerform experiments.⚗️
seoImprove SEO.🔍️
typesAdd or update types.🏷️
ideaImplement / Test Idea🌱
animationAdd or update animations and transitions.💫
inspectData exploration/inspection.🧐
test-failAdd a failing test.🧪
BuslogicAdd or update business logic.👔
checkAdd or update healthcheck.🩺
sponsorAdd sponsorships or money related infrastructure.💸
validationAdd or update code related to validation.🦺
graphicsAdd or update graphics.🎬
validationAdd or update code related to validation.🛟
